definitions.explanation: The power or ability of something to produce an intended effect. Often used in legal and official contexts to mean 'validity' or 'legal force' of a document, law, or agreement.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{効力|こうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{効力|こうりょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: The contract takes effect starting next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すでに{効力|こうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}っている→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: This law has already lost its validity.

notes:
Commonly used in legal, regulatory, and pharmaceutical contexts. Compared to ⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ (effect, result), {効力|こうりょく} emphasizes the inherent power or force something possesses, especially in an official or binding sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {効力|こうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — to be effective, to be valid
- {効力|こうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧ — to lose validity/efficacy
- {効力|こうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧ — to exert its effect
- {効力|こうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧ — to take effect
- ⟦{法的|ほうてき}→法的：13300_houteki⟧{効力|こうりょく} — legal force/validity
